questions.question: Which Liquid syntax format is used to indicate a dynamic object?
questions.explanation: The ${} syntax is used in Liquid to indicate a dynamic object that will be replaced with personalization data.

questions.question: What element in the following catalog call is used to identify the catalog item within the corresponding Braze catalog? {% catalog_items Summer_Menu_2025 spicychickensandwich %} [items[0].Product_Name] [[items[0].Product_Price]]]
questions.explanation: spicychickensandwich is the catalog item identifier used to access the specific item from the Summer_Menu_2025 catalog.
